entries.title: Revelation of John 14:1
segments: And I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on the mount Zion, and with him a hundred and forty and four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:2
segments: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and the voice which I heard [was] as [the voice] of harpers harping with their harps:

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:3
segments: and they sing as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders: and no man could learn the song save the hundred and forty and four thousand, [even] they that had been purchased out of the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:4
segments: These are they that were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These [are] they that follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were purchased from among men, [to be] the firstfruits unto God and unto the Lamb.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:5
segments: And in their mouth was found no lie: they are without blemish.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:6
segments: And I saw another angel flying in mid heaven, having eternal good tidings to proclaim unto them that dwell on the earth, and unto every nation and tribe and tongue and people;

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:7
segments: and he saith with a great voice, Fear God, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made the heaven and the earth and sea and fountains of waters.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:8
segments: And another, a second angel, followed, saying, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, that hath made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:9
segments: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, If any man worshippeth the beast and his image, and receiveth a mark on his forehead, or upon his hand,

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:10
segments: he also shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:11
segments: and the smoke of their torment goeth up for ever and ever; and they have no rest day and night, they that worship the beast and his image, and whoso receiveth the mark of his name.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:12
segments: Here is the patience of the saints, they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:13
segments: And I heard the voice from heaven saying, Write, Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from henceforth: yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:14
segments: And I saw, and behold, a white cloud; and on the cloud [I saw] one sitting like unto a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand sharp sickle.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:15
segments: And another angel came out from the temple, crying with a great voice to him that sat on the cloud, Send forth thy sickle, and reap: for the hour to reap is come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:16
segments: And he that sat on the cloud cast his sickle upon the earth; and the earth was reaped.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:17
segments: Another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:18
segments: And another angel came out from the altar, he that hath power over fire; and he called with a great voice to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Send forth thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:19
segments: And the angel cast his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and cast it into the winepress, the great [winepress], of the wrath of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 14:20
segments: And the winepress are trodden without the city, and there came out blood from the winepress, even unto the bridles of the horses, as far as a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
